epistemic_policy: Every discovered record remains CANDIDATE_UNREVIEWED until human review.
Model-generated synthesis, classifications, embeddings, inferred entities and reasoning chains are not evidence.
Similarity does not imply historical descent, common origin or diffusion.
Publication, issue, version, index and discovery dates are preserved separately where available.
Archaeological observations are separated from inferred symbolic, ritual, social or cognitive meaning.
Ancient-DNA affinity, morphology, culture, language, technology and social identity are not interchangeable variables.
Imputed, predicted, reconstructed or model-classified values are not treated as directly observed measurements.
Historical diagnosis or identity is never inferred from resemblance to modern biomedical categories.

new_candidates.title: Construction of multimodal oracle bone semantic reasoning and knowledge graphs in archaeology under artificial intelligence technology
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Presents a multimodal image-text pipeline and knowledge-graph reasoning framework for oracle bone inscriptions, potentially useful for source retrieval and provenance-aware historical corpora.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: AI-extracted entities, relations, alignments and reasoning chains are model outputs, not archaeological or historical evidence. Any NOEMA use must preserve source-image, transcription, edition and human-validation provenance.

new_candidates.title: Co-mutation Based Genetic Networks to Infer Temporal Mutation Dynamics in Ancient Human Mitochondrial Genomes
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Analyzes 812 ancient mitochondrial consensus genomes across six periods using co-mutation and phylogeny-based networks to characterize temporal genetic variation.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Temporal mtDNA network structure and haplogroup composition do not directly observe diet, lifestyle, culture or adaptation. Population structure, demography and phylogeny can confound temporal associations; the study also notes non-uniform raw-read processing and unassessed residual NUMT contamination.

provenance.publisher: Journal of Molecular Evolution / Springer Nature

new_candidates.title: Internal structure of Mammoth ivory inspired the design of Mizyn (Ukraine) Upper Palaeolithic figurines
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Digital and microscopic analysis of 18 Mizyn ivory figurines reports that natural Schreger and Owen lines in mammoth ivory informed engraved geometric compositions; the paper also synthesizes recalibrated radiocarbon contexts for European Palaeolithic figurines.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Material affordance shaping a motif does not exclude symbolism, and symbolism is not a decoded private meaning. The chronological synthesis should be reviewed at record level before altering any NOEMA art-sequence dates.

dating_change.scope: Mizyn and comparative post-LGM figurine contexts; candidate only

provenance.version_status: accepted early citable version; final Version of Record pending

new_candidates.title: Sedimentary Ancient DNA Tracks Multi-Kingdom Ecosystem Reorganizations Following Sequential Human Land Use at Crawford Lake
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Uses Crawford Lake varved sediments and sedimentary ancient DNA across roughly 1,300 years to reconstruct multi-kingdom ecosystem changes across Indigenous agriculture, abandonment/succession and later Euro-Canadian land use.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: sedaDNA is a proxy with preservation and capture-bait detection constraints. Ecological change cannot be collapsed into a direct causal measure of culture, belief or intent, and Indigenous histories should not be reduced to molecular proxies.

new_candidates.title: Crops in Motion: Strontium Isotope Analysis of Cereal Provenance in a Foraging-Oriented Neolithic Economy
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Applies 87Sr/86Sr to a small, stratigraphically constrained sample of charred cereals from Molino Casarotto, Italy, with a local baseline and radiocarbon checks; results support heterogeneous non-local crop supply.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Non-local grain does not establish human migration, market institutions, trade partners or producer identity. Sample size is small and baseline/diagenetic uncertainties remain.

provenance.publisher: Journal of Archaeological Method and Theory / Springer Nature

new_candidates.title: Neural tracking at theta predicts drumming-induced altered states of consciousness
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: In 40 participants, 4-Hz neural tracking correlated with stronger reported altered experience, although 4-bps drumming did not produce significantly higher group-level altered-experience scores than the other rhythms.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: A modern laboratory EEG association cannot establish the function, meaning, historical continuity or biological mechanism of prehistoric or ethnographic ritual drumming. Cross-cultural resemblance does not imply descent.

new_candidates.title: Dating burial histories: radiocarbon wiggle-match of Kurgan 8 at Uzun Rama (Western Azerbaijan)
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Tree-ring-defined radiocarbon wiggle-matching of a Juniperus sample associated with the Kurgan 8 wooden closure structure refines the ritual closure of the main chamber to likely shortly after 3204–3174 BCE (95.4% hpd).
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: The refined range constrains the wood/closure event, not every burial or later reuse episode. Several burial contexts remain undated, and later disturbance/revisitation complicates whole-monument chronology.

contradictions_and_method_pressures.finding: Machine-derived entities, relations and reasoning chains can improve retrieval but must not enter NOEMA as source-level historical observations without human validation and source anchors.
Temporal mtDNA network patterns cannot be read directly as lifestyle or adaptive transitions; population history, phylogeny and sequence-processing limitations remain competing explanations.

Natural ivory structure appears to have shaped engraved geometry, pressuring interpretations that treat visual pattern entirely as free-standing symbolic design; this does not negate possible symbolism.
sedaDNA reconstruction is preservation- and bait-set-dependent and must not substitute for historical or Indigenous-source context.
Non-local cereal isotope signatures support provenance differences but not a unique exchange mechanism, market structure or human migration pathway.
Modern EEG/rhythm associations cannot be projected backward as proof of prehistoric trance, shamanism, ritual function or historical continuity.
A high-resolution closure event date must not be generalized to all interments or later monument reuse; undated contexts remain unknown.
